user.title: Connect to WMATA
user.description: Add a station, bus stop or systemwide train map. You can add more entries later. Get a subscribed API key from {api_key_url}.

location.title: Choose your station or bus stop
location.description: Rail: choose a station or enter its code; all platforms and lines are included. Bus: enter the seven-digit stop ID. Each location gets one arrival board. Add optional saved journeys using Configure after setup.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to WMATA
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a working WMATA API key.

error.invalid_auth: WMATA rejected the API key. Check your developer subscription and key.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to WMATA. Try again later.
error.invalid_location: Enter a valid rail station code or seven-digit bus stop ID.

abort.already_configured: This station or bus stop is already configured.

add_journey.title: Add a saved journey
add_journey.description: Match any selected line/route and any selected destination. A train destination means its terminus, not an intermediate station you want to visit. Rail directions describe travel toward the next station and depend on the station and destination. Unknown directions do not match a direction filter. Empty filters accept all arrivals. Journey sensors share the station board’s requests.

journey.title: Edit saved journey
journey.description: Match any selected line/route and any selected destination. A train destination means its terminus, not an intermediate station you want to visit. Rail directions describe travel toward the next station and depend on the station and destination. Unknown directions do not match a direction filter. Empty filters accept all arrivals. Journey sensors share the station board’s requests.

remove_journey.title: Choose a journey to remove
remove_journey.description: This removes its sensor. The station arrival board is unaffected.

error.duplicate_name: A journey with this name already exists at this station.

abort.no_journeys: No saved journeys exist for this station yet. Choose Add a journey to create one.
abort.journey_not_found: This journey no longer exists. Reopen Configure.
